tip_meanings.amethyst: A bounded delayed echo of a supported damage or healing outcome.
tip_meanings.diamond: A bounded distribution of supported damage or healing to nearby recipients.
tip_meanings.emerald: A conditional rebate of actually paid mana, with additional wear.
tip_meanings.ender_pearl: An optional short caster backstep after a supported cast.
tip_meanings.copper: An additional bounded electrical outcome after eligible damage.
tip_meanings.iron: An additional bounded push after eligible damage, healing or protection.
tip_meanings.ghast_tear: A bounded caster restoration following the authored successful outcome.
tip_meanings.netherite: Caster stability with additional mana and preparation.

components.meaning: Economy thread: less mana with additional preparation.
Endurance thread: more maximum durability with additional preparation.
Damage thread: a compatible Kindled contribution, with mana and wear trade-offs.
Preparation thread: faster preparation with increased mana.
Support thread: a compatible Purifying contribution with increased mana.
